scripts.start: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs citizen && ng serve frontend --proxy-config proxy.conf.json
scripts.start:admin: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs admin && ng serve admin --port 4300 --proxy-config proxy.conf.json
scripts.start:worker: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs worker && ng serve worker --port 4400 --proxy-config proxy.conf.json
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs citizen && ng build frontend
scripts.build:admin: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs admin && ng build admin
scripts.build:worker: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs worker && ng build worker
scripts.dev: node scripts/generate-runtime-config.mjs citizen && ng serve frontend --proxy-config proxy.conf.json
